MemoryStore.NamedExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.name === "", s.description === "", s.memory_count === 0].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
				[s.status !== "", s.name !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

MemoryStore.OnlyAnActiveStoreChangesWhat.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "active",
				[
					after.name === before.name,
					after.description === before.description,
					after.memory_count === before.memory_count,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[before.status === "", after.status === "active", after.memory_count === 0].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

MemoryStore.CountMovesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count,
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count + 1,
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count - 1,
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.PlacedExactlyWhenWritten.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.memory_store_id === "",
					s.path === "",
					s.content_sha256 === "",
					s.version === 0,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.memory_store_id !== "", s.path !== "", s.version >= 1].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.AMemoryNeverLeavesItsPlace.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[after.memory_store_id === before.memory_store_id, after.path === before.path].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[after.version === before.version, after.status === before.status].every((ok) => ok),
				after.version === before.version + 1,
			].some((ok) => ok)

WriteMemory.AWriteLeavesTheMemoryPresent.source:
({ after, command }) =>
			[
				after.memory.status === "present",
				after.memory.memory_store_id === command.memory_store_id,
				after.memory.path === command.path,
				after.memory.content_sha256 === command.content_sha256,
			].every((ok) => ok)

WriteMemory.ANewMemoryCountsOnceAndWithi.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.store.memory_count ===
					before.store.memory_count + (before.memory.status === "present" ? 0 : 1),
				after.store.memory_count <= MAX_MEMORIES_PER_STORE,
			].every((ok) => ok)

DeleteMemory.ADeleteRemovesOnePresentMem.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.store.status === "active",
				before.memory.status === "present",
				after.memory.status === "deleted",
				after.store.memory_count === before.store.memory_count - 1,
			].every((ok) => ok)

Memories.AStoreCountsItsPresentMemories.source:
(m) =>
			m.MemoryStore.every(
				(store) =>
					store.state.status === "" ||
					store.state.status === "deleted" ||
					store.state.memory_count ===
						m.Memory.filter(
							(memory) =>
								memory.state.status === "present" && memory.state.memory_store_id === store.id,
						).length,
			)

Memories.TheIndexListsEachStoresPresentM.source:
(m) =>
			[
				m.MemoryIndex.every((index) =>
					index.state.entries.every((entry) =>
						m.Memory.some((memory) =>
							[
								memory.id === entry.id,
								memory.state.status === "present",
								memory.state.memory_store_id === index.id,
								memory.state.path === entry.path,
								memory.state.content_sha256 === entry.content_sha256,
							].every((ok) => ok),
						),
					),
				),
				m.Memory.every(
					(memory) =>
						memory.state.status !== "present" ||
						m.MemoryIndex.some(
							(index) =>
								index.id === memory.state.memory_store_id &&
								index.state.entries.some((entry) => entry.id === memory.id),
						),
				),
			].every((ok) => ok)

Memories.APresentMemoryIsInAStoreThatWas.source:
({ memory, store }) =>
				[
					memory.state.status !== "present",
					memory.state.memory_store_id !== store.id,
					store.state.status !== "",
				].some((ok) => ok)
